design_brief.description: Parametric CAD model of a geared DC motor assembly with an integrated round gearbox and output shaft. Includes a 37 mm diameter cylindrical gearbox (24.5 mm tall), a 35.6 mm diameter cylindrical motor can (32 mm long) attached coaxially, and a 6 mm diameter output shaft (14.7 mm long) protruding from the gearbox front face. Metadata includes typical 12V rating and 200 RPM no-load speed.

metadata.description: Parametric geared DC motor assembly (typical 12V, ~200 RPM no-load). Includes round gearbox, motor can, interface step, front face boss, output shaft, and simplified motor shaft + grommet parts as coaxial rings.

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A geared DC motor with integrated gearbox: 37 mm diameter round gearbox, 24.5 mm tall, 35.6 mm motor diameter, 32 mm motor length, 6 mm shaft diameter, 14.7 mm shaft length. The motor should have a typical voltage rating of 12V and a no-load speed of 200 RPM.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): gearbox_body, motor_can, output_shaft, motor_shaft, geared_stepper, round_grommet_assembly, round_grommet_bottom, round_grommet_top
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 37mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: gearbox_diameter≈37.0mm, gearbox_height≈24.5mm, motor_diameter≈35.6mm, motor_length≈32.0mm, shaft_diameter≈6.0mm, shaft_length≈14.7mm
NOTE: Voltage (12V) and no-load speed (200 RPM) are treated as non-geometric metadata; no electrical connectors, mounting holes, or wiring are specified in the request.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
